title: 第351章 灵愈者第353章 灭虫小队
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “首领，这次我们斩杀了37条灰烬蠕虫，那些讨厌的寒焰鬼鸦也已经清理干净了。”
一个矮人快步凑了过来向布隆石汇报着战果，脸上还沾着些许尘土和蠕虫粘液。
布隆石点了点头，目光扫过四周狼藉的战场：“族人们有受伤吗？有没有出现伤亡？”
在他心中，族人的安全，远比斩杀多少怪物都重要。
那矮人一脸凝重：“有5个族人受伤了，都是被灰烬蠕虫的獠牙划伤的，其他四个伤势不算严重，可小卡隆的伤势很重，他的一只胳膊被蠕虫撕咬得血肉模糊，险些被扯掉。”
“什么？”
布隆石面色一变，再也顾不上林奇四人，大步朝着矮人村落狂奔而去，每一步都震得地面微微发颤。
在矮人村庄的空地上，
五个受伤的矮人正躺在铺着兽皮的石台上，身上缠着粗糙的麻布绷带。
其中一个年轻矮人的胳膊上，绷带早已被鲜血浸透，暗红色的血液顺着绷带不断流淌。
即便已经做了简单包扎，也根本止不住，看得人触目惊心。
周遭围站着十几个矮人，个个面色担忧，却又手足无措。
他们擅长锻造，能打造出削铁如泥的武器、坚不可摧的铠甲，可对于治疗伤势却一窍不通，只能做些简单的包扎，根本无法应对如此严重的伤口。
“首领。”
见到布隆石匆匆赶来，围站的矮人们纷纷起身，脸上露出一丝希冀。
他们都盼着首领能有办法救下小卡隆。
布隆石快步走到石台边，目光落在小卡隆渗血的伤口，心脏一揪：“上过伤药了吗？情况怎么样？”
“已经上过伤药了，其他四个族人的伤势还好，只要好好休养就能恢复，可小卡隆的胳膊……伤口太深，筋骨都受损严重，恐怕是救不过来了。”
林奇被一个矮人拎在手中，仅仅扫了一眼，就看出了问题。
这些矮人的包扎手段极其落后，只是简单地用麻布裹住伤口，根本没有处理伤口内部的损伤，也没有止血的效果。
这样下去，小卡隆就算不死，也一定会失去这条胳膊。
“矮人大叔，我可以帮你治疗你的族人。”
他手中有不少治愈卡，对付这种伤势简直绰绰有余，既能救下小卡隆，也能缓和与矮人的关系，说不定还能找到离开秘境的方法。
闻言，布隆石眼前一亮，当即撕开丝网，将梅比斯轻轻提溜了出来。
“灵愈者大人，请你务必帮帮我的族人，只要能救下小卡隆，我们矮人一族定当全力回报你，无论你想要什么，只要我们能做到，绝不推辞！”
说着，布隆石竟对着小小的梅比斯双手合十，姿态恭敬，丝毫没有了之前领主级矮人的强悍与威严，只剩下满心的恳求。
林奇一脸懵逼。
“不是……刚刚说话的是我啊！怎么直接越过我去找梅比斯了？”
更让他疑惑的是：“这个矮人怎么知道梅比斯会治疗的？灵愈者是什么？”
梅比斯甩了甩身上残留的丝网粘液，抬头看向石台上受伤的小卡隆。
小脸上没有了往日的调皮，反而多了几分认真。
她生性善良，见不得有人受这么重的伤。
没有丝毫犹豫，梅比斯迈步朝着石台走去。
content_en:
"Chief, we killed 37 Ash Worms this time, and those nasty Cold Flame Ghost Crows have also been cleaned up."
A dwarf quickly came over to report the results of the battle to Blomstone, with some dust and worm slime on his face.
Bronze nodded and glanced at the messy battlefield around him: "Are the tribesmen injured? Are there any casualties?"
In his heart, the safety of his people is far more important than how many monsters he kills.
The dwarf had a solemn look on his face: "Five tribesmen were injured, all scratched by the fangs of the ash worm. The other four injuries were not serious, but little Caron's injury was very serious. One of his arms was bitten by the worm until it was bloody and bloody, and it was almost torn off."
"What?"
Bronze's expression changed, and he no longer cared about Lynch and the other four, and ran towards the dwarf village with long strides, making the ground tremble slightly with every step he took.
In the open space of the dwarf village,
Five injured dwarves were lying on a stone platform covered with animal skins, their bodies wrapped in rough linen bandages.
The bandage on the arm of one of the young dwarves had already been soaked with blood, and dark red blood continued to flow along the bandage.
Even after a simple bandage, it couldn't be stopped at all, which was shocking to see.
There were a dozen dwarves standing around, all looking worried but at a loss.
They are good at forging and can create weapons as sharp as clay and indestructible armor, but they know nothing about treating injuries. They can only make simple bandages, which are completely unable to deal with such serious wounds.
"Chief."
Seeing Blomstone rushing over, the dwarves standing around stood up one after another, with a hint of hope on their faces.
They all hope that the leader can find a way to save little Caron.
Blomstone walked quickly to the stone platform, his eyes fell on the bleeding wound of little Kalon, and his heart twitched: "Have you been given any medicine? How is the situation?"
"The wounds have been treated with medicine. The injuries of the other four tribesmen are okay. They can recover as long as they take a good rest. But the wound on little Caron's arm... is too deep and the muscles and bones are severely damaged. I'm afraid it cannot be saved."
Lin Qi was held in the hands of a dwarf, and after just one glance, he saw the problem.
The dressing methods of these dwarves were extremely backward. They simply wrapped the wound with linen cloth, without treating the internal damage of the wound at all, and had no effect on stopping the bleeding.
If this continues, even if little Caron doesn't die, he will definitely lose his arm.
"Uncle Dwarf, I can help you heal your people."
He has a lot of healing cards in his hand, which are more than enough to deal with this kind of injury. He can not only save little Caron, but also ease the relationship with the dwarves, and maybe find a way to leave the secret realm.
Upon hearing this, Bronze's eyes lit up, and he immediately tore open the silk screen and gently lifted Mavis out.
"Lord Spirit Healer, please help my people. As long as we can save little Caron, we, the dwarves, will repay you with all our strength. No matter what you want, as long as we can do it, we will never refuse!"
As he said this, Bronstone clasped his hands in front of the little Mebis with a respectful gesture. He lost all the strength and majesty of the previous lord-level dwarf, only full of pleading.
Lin Qi looked confused.
"No...it was me who spoke just now! Why did you go directly past me to find Mavis?"
What made him even more confused was: "How does this dwarf know that Mebis can heal? What is a spiritual healer?"
Mavis shook off the remaining silk mesh slime on his body and looked up at the injured little Caron on the stone platform.
The little face no longer had the naughty look of the past, but instead looked a little more serious.
She has a kind nature and doesn't want to see anyone being hurt so badly.
Without any hesitation, Mavis stepped towards the stone platform.
